subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: Should OpenClaw remove full inline systemPromptReport from persisted session entries by splitting out compact warning-dedupe state and recomputing diagnostics when needed?
rationale: The code path is clear, but maintainers need to choose the durable semantics for prompt diagnostics, warning dedupe across restarts, and inactive-session storage before automation changes the session state shape.

options.title: Split compact state and drop inline report
options.body: Persist only the small warning/report state needed across restarts and rebuild diagnostics on demand, addressing the bloat without losing dedupe behavior.

options.title: Keep report inline for now
options.body: Accept the sessions.json size cost until a broader database-first session migration or diagnostics redesign owns the storage shape.

options.title: Land skills-only mitigation separately
options.body: Treat the linked PR as a partial skillsSnapshot fix and keep this issue open for the systemPromptReport payload.

recommendation.title: Split compact state and drop inline report
recommendation.body: Persist only the small warning/report state needed across restarts and rebuild diagnostics on demand, addressing the bloat without losing dedupe behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent merged session-store prompt-blob mitigation and merged adjacent session-store normalization work.
